title: Cartwise+ Membership Plan Change Terms by Plan
content:
Each Cartwise+ Membership plan lists the plans it may switch to. The switch terms per plan are:

| Plan | May switch to | Switch to a higher-fee plan takes effect | Switch to an equal- or lower-fee plan takes effect | Unused part of the old fee credited by | Switches allowed per paid period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | Cartwise+ Monthly, Cartwise+ Annual | immediately | at the next renewal | unused days | 1 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | Cartwise+ Monthly, Cartwise+ Annual | immediately | at the next renewal | unused days | 1 |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | Cartwise+ Assist Monthly, Cartwise+ Student Monthly, Cartwise+ Annual, Cartwise+ Family Annual, Cartwise+ Premier Annual | immediately | at the next renewal | unused days | 1 |
| Cartwise+ Annual | Cartwise+ Monthly, Cartwise+ Family Annual, Cartwise+ Premier Annual | immediately | at the next renewal | unused days | 1 |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | Cartwise+ Annual, Cartwise+ Premier Annual | immediately | at the next renewal | unused days | 1 |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | Cartwise+ Annual, Cartwise+ Family Annual | immediately | at the next renewal | unused days | 1 |

## Column meanings

- **May switch to**: the official plan names this plan may switch to; a plan not listed is not a permitted target.
- **Higher-fee / equal- or lower-fee timing**: whether the switch takes effect immediately or at the next renewal date, judged by comparing the two plans' period fees.
- **Credited by unused days**: the unused part of the old plan's fee is credited toward an immediate switch according to the days of the current period left unused.
- **Switches per paid period**: the number of plan switches allowed in one paid period.
